name: Wild Speech (4 Winds Fantasy Gaming)
body:
You can talk with others even when in animal form.

Prerequisite: 6th-level druid

Benefit: You retain the ability to speak while in animal form, plus you can still communicate with animals of the type of form you are in.

Normal: You lose the ability to speak while in animal form when using your wild shape class feature.
